variants.name: Force 05A — Rond
variants.label: PULSE 05A / ROND
variants.description: Een ronde oranje stip boven de i. De R staat op dezelfde letterhoogte en is smaller gemaakt, zodat revive meer als één woord leest.
variants.prompt:
Edit the supplied Pulse 05 / FORCE moodboard into a new focused logo variation, 1536x1024 landscape. Keep Force's orange/black/off-white/burgundy palette, broad pixel-block trails, supporting GT Eesti Display, human business photography, financing website/app/printed proposal and both slogans. Main user request is a correctly scaled first R and variations of the i dot.
CRITICAL CHANGE — R SIZE: the source's first R still looks like a broad emblem. Redraw it as a REAL LETTER within revive: its visible top and bottom EXACTLY align to the top and baseline of the adjacent e/v bodies (lowercase x-height). DO NOT align R to the upper edge of the i dot. R must not be taller, heavier or visually bigger than evive. Narrow its overall width to approximately one e-letter width (maximum 1.15 times an e), rather than the current oversized emblem width. Same italic slant, same optical stem weight, normal inter-letter gap as the following letters. Retain a clear R bowl, parallel inner channel and unmistakable diagonal lower-right leg. Simplify the R's channel slightly if needed for proper typographic proportion. Not P/F and not a separate emblem. Exactly SIX letters: custom R followed directly by evive. Name revive only.
All letters except dot share one colour in the main wordmark: offwhite on carbon, carbon on paper. Keep the original Force's extended strong italic evive style. Every full wordmark must use exactly the SAME compact first R and same dot variation: primary, mono, reverse, website, app and proposal. Standalone same R may appear in the icon tile. Clearly show matching small mono and reverse wordmarks. Add a small clean wordmark specimen with thin x-height/baseline guides to make equal letter height visible; main logo remains unadorned. Keep enough room for a large readable logo.
DOT VARIATION will be specified below. The dot must sit above the i stem, separated by a clear gap, centered optically over the slanted stem; not replace the i stem or become a floating accent over another letter. Orange #F46529 in colour logo; same solid ink as rest of logo in true mono specimens. No other orange letter strokes or extra glyphs.
Keep full source moodboard scope and overall comparison-friendly composition. Preserve pixel energy and capable finance feel. NO cars, roads, racing vehicles or medical imagery. No new marketing copy. Remove any decorative text on photo background walls.
Exact slogans, both clearly legible and unchanged:
"Financiering op het moment dat het telt."
"Het antwoord terwijl iedereen aan tafel zit."
Other text only concept title, brand name, palette labels/hex codes and short functional labels. Palette unchanged: Carbon #171719, Oranje #F46529, Papier #F5EEE4, Bordeaux #742D43. GT Eesti Display supporting type reference; the logo is custom.
The image should visibly correct the R size and isolate a distinctive i-dot treatment while retaining the selected FORCE identity.
Title: "PULSE 05A / ROND". Dot: ONE PERFECT SOLID ORANGE CIRCLE. Clean round disk, diameter approximately the thickness of the i stem, with a generous visible air gap. Circle stays round despite italic lettering. It is clearly different from the source's square/slanted dot. No second dot, no square accent elsewhere in wordmark. Same circular dot in every logo application.

variants.name: Force 05B — Snede
variants.label: PULSE 05B / SNEDE
variants.description: Een korte schuine oranje balk boven de i. Deze vorm sluit aan op de voorwaartse helling en de snedes in het woordmerk.
